description: Labeled pair corpus for Phase 3 consolidation duplicate detection (plugins/memory/holographic/consolidation.py's plan_candidate(), exercising the baseline token-overlap check together with the new fuzzy N-gram evidence -- a 'match' pair should be classified 'ignored' by either signal, a 'no_match' pair must stay 'inserted' regardless of raw text similarity). Each case is a pair of already-firewall-accepted fact contents. This does not test the full capture/extraction pipeline -- that has its own corpus in test_holographic_capture_eval.py. Thresholds (_FUZZY_DUPLICATE_NGRAM_OVERLAP, _FUZZY_VALUE_SWAP_GUARD) were calibrated against this corpus, not the other way around -- see consolidation.py's module docstring for the worked examples these numbers come from.
